heading: Today
text: Scattered morning showers giving way to some breaks of sun. Additional showers and locally strong thunderstorms midday and afternoon, a few with gusty winds and heavy rain. Highs in the 70s to near 80. Winds from the south 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, shifting to the west late.

heading: Tonight
text: Scattered evening showers and thunderstorms, mostly from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north. Clouds giving way to gradual clearing west to east. Patches of valley fog late. Lows in the 50s to low 60s, warmest east of the Green Mountains. Winds west to northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph this evening, decreasing overnight.

heading: Tuesday
text: Some patchy valley fog early, then mostly sunny. Much less humid. Highs in the upper 70s to low 80s. Winds light, mainly west up to 10 mph.
